about: Email sign-in when Supabase refuses to send (contract/email-sign-in-2026-10-15.md § Already sent). 'send' maps a failed signInWithOtp (HTTP status, error code, message) to an outcome: already_sent (the per-address minute: a code went out moments ago, so go to the code step and count down 'wait' seconds), too_many (the project's hourly email cap, or too many requests from this network: no code is on its way), or failed. 'restore' is whether a code step saved at 'sent_at' (seconds) comes back at 'now': within 3600 s (the code's life) it does, with resend_at = sent_at + 60 unless a later resend_at was saved. iOS EmailSignInTests, web emailSignIn.test.ts and Android EmailSignInTest read this. 'review' is whether an address is the store review account (contract § Review account): trimmed and lowercased, only appreview@table-1.site itself; its code is a password, so no email is sent.
